description.narrative: 4.1 Number of additional refurbishments and equipment procured and fully operational

comment.narrative: After a competitive process Spectrum company was contracted to create bidding documents and support during bidding process as well as ensuring the supervision of the construction and rehabilitation works and handing over.Fences were initially planned to be funded by ISF but due to the financial crisis it was not possible. Therefore UNODC sought the support of other donors and agreed with Bureau of International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs INL to handle the procurement of engineering services for the fences. After a long discussion with ISF engineering department a consensus was reached in November on the fence specification taking into consideration international standards and the security requirements. As for the solar system which is imperative within the current context a positive indication from UNDP under another EU funded project to include in the ISF segment Warwar as priority for 2024. This should be further confirmed by ISF in January 2024. These panels will ensure complete green energy at the facility not only helping the environment but reducing running costs of the facility in terms of generator fuel. Neither the fence nor solar panels were covered by this project however without them the relocation of children to Warwar would not be feasible. Procurement for engineering services of Warwar refurbishment was finalized in December after site visits from potential bidders.
